config.label: Your Prometiam API key as a Bearer token (Bearer rk_live_
config.description: Your Prometiam API key as a Bearer token (Bearer rk_live_...; the word Bearer is optional). Optional: with no header the server runs in demo mode on a shared key (30 requests a minute and 2,000 calls a day for everyone; sanctions screening and company events need your own key). Your own key comes with a 14-day free trial of 500 credits (a card is required, nothing is charged during it): https://www.prometiam.com/signup?utm_source=mcp
